base.A.5.2: LI-RACI names 10 ISMS roles, one for each ISMS process. A holder is named at Manila for 7 of them, and 4 of those 7 have signed the role's responsibilities (Manila HR file).
base.A.5.3: The A.5.3 list holds 2 conflicting duties (CIT-S1). Since 12 October 2026 the procurement team creates suppliers, so the finance clerk only approves their payments. Since 2 November 2026 a second network administrator approves each firewall change.
base.A.5.18: Leavers from 1 September to 30 November 2026: 18, of them 6 involuntary. All 12 voluntary leavers were disabled within 4 hours. 5 of the 6 involuntary leavers were disabled within 1 hour; the sixth after 3 hours (IAM disable log).
base.A.5.22: The Manila vendor register tiers 7 suppliers Critical or High. Reassessments due in the 12 months to 30 November 2026: 6 (one High supplier is not yet due). Done by their due date: 4. Overdue: the outside payroll provider and a telecom carrier.
base.A.8.8: VUL-TEST (T9.2), measured on 30 November 2026 as SITL-POL-010 Section 10 sets out. Class 1: 6 findings, 4 within SLA. Class 2: 18 findings, 13 within SLA. Class 3: 10 findings, 9 within SLA. Class 4: 6 findings, 6 within SLA.

A.5.2: Count the roles with a named holder instead, so the value reads 70.0% and the measure is out of the red.

Stop measuring: both conflicts are dealt with, so the target is met for good.
Keep measuring each quarter, and write down how conflicts are found and kept apart, so the result holds as people change.
A.5.18: Ask the IAM team lead why one involuntary leaver took 3 hours, fix the cause, and measure again next month.
Take it to the management review as a nonconformity now: the target is 100%.
No action: 94.4% is close enough to the target.
A.5.22: Re-tier the payroll provider and the carrier to Medium, so their reassessments are not due yet.
Measure again next quarter: the two reassessments may be done by then.
Have the two overdue reassessments done by 31 January 2027, owner the Vendor / Third-Party Risk Analyst, with the Org CISO reporting progress to the management review.
A.8.8: Lower the target to 80%: the office cannot reach 90% this year.
Ask the Org CISO to approve a remediation plan for the overdue class 1–2 findings, owner the Vulnerability Management Governance Analyst, and report it to the management review.
